scope: Existing original SwordWeave art only; no new art, renderer edits, manuscript edits or third-party artwork copies.
selection_policy: Choose an image for a named learning task, not a monster gallery or blank-page filler.
Keep original names and identity; none of the public characters is Torren, Mira or Ilex.
Use the 1254px portraits around 3.1–3.7 inches. Full-page enlargement is below native 300ppi.
Use scenes as meaningful half-page/part-opener plates, with readable captions and adjacent lessons.
Use the two genuinely transparent illustrations without a rectangular frame. The other assets have deliberately opaque backgrounds.
Distribute masked role images across chapters. Do not run a repetitive catalogue of near-identical portrait poses.
Artwork can establish atmosphere or a visual example; it never creates a mechanical permission.
